check_IsKeyword: check if a given token is a C++ keyword using the IsKeyword function
check_IsBuiltinType: check if a given token is a C++ builtin type using the IsBuiltinType function
list_ALL_keywords: list all C++ keywords by inspecting the ALL set constant
list_TYPES: list C++ type keywords by inspecting the TYPES set constant
list_CONTROL_keywords: list C++ control flow keywords by inspecting the CONTROL set constant
